question: Which companies are most active in multiple myeloma? Please count J&J and Celgene programs correctly.

answer.answer_md:
## Most active industry lead sponsors in Multiple Myeloma (D009101)

Ranked by **n_active_trials** (with total n_trials as tiebreak), scoped to **industry lead sponsors only** (v_sponsor_condition), per house-rule default for Q3.

| Rank | Company | Active trials | Total trials | Assets | Phase 3+ trials |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Johnson & Johnson (Janssen) | 45 | 85 | 38 | 32 |
| 2 | Bristol Myers Squibb | 24 | 103 | 64 | 30 |
| 2 (tie, active) | GSK | 24 | 39 | 28 | 8 |
| 4 | AbbVie | 17 | 32 | 25 | 6 |
| 5 | Pfizer | 14 | 30 | 35 | 7 |
| 6 | Roche (Genentech) | 12 | 24 | 30 | 2 |
| 7 | Regeneron | 11 | 13 | 18 | 4 |
| 8 | Sanofi | 9 | 31 | 27 | 7 |
| 8 (tie) | AstraZeneca | 9 | 15 | 20 | 3 |
| 10 | Takeda | 5 | 35 | 23 | 14 |

**On J&J vs. Celgene specifically:** in this index, entity resolution folds legacy/acquired-brand sponsor names into their present-day parent identity. Johnson & Johnson (Janssen) programs are counted under the single sponsor id `johnson johnson janssen` (85 total MM trials, 45 active, 38 distinct assets — e.g. NCT00097981 onward). Celgene resolves to **Bristol Myers Squibb** (`bristol myers squibb`) — since BMS acquired Celgene in 2019, all Celgene-led myeloma trials (e.g. NCT00044018 onward) are attributed to the BMS lead-sponsor id, giving BMS 103 total / 24 active / 64 distinct assets. There is no separate "Celgene" row in the index to double-count or split out — its trial history is already merged into BMS. So the correct read is: **J&J (Janssen) = 85 trials / 45 active**, and **Celgene's programs live entirely inside BMS's 103 trials / 24 active** — do not add a standalone Celgene count on top of BMS, and don't subtract BMS's legacy-Celgene trials from J&J (they are disjoint sponsor lineages).

By this metric, J&J (Janssen) is the single most active MM sponsor by active-trial count, while BMS (which subsumes Celgene) has the broadest total historical footprint (most trials and most distinct assets, 64) among all industry sponsors in this indication.

FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id) WHERE p.condition_key = 'D002292' AND NOT a.is_combo

       list(DISTINCT cp.nct_id) AS nct_ids FROM v_combo_partners cp JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = cp.partner_asset_id
